        mask=reversed_offsets < seqlen,
        other=0.0,

        group = 1 << (stage + 1)

        group_base = offsets & ~(group - 1)

        upper_indices = lower_indices + half

        lower_imag = tl.gather(imag, lower_indices, axis=0)

        upper_imag = tl.gather(imag, upper_indices, axis=0)

            lower_real + product_real,
            lower_real - product_real,

        index2 = index1 + quarter

        diff0_real = real0 - product1_real
        diff0_imag = imag0 - product1_imag

        sum2_imag = imag2 + product3_imag

        diff2_imag = imag2 - product3_imag

        rotated_diff2_imag = (
            twiddle_imag * diff2_imag - twiddle_real * diff2_real
        )

        output0_imag = sum0_imag + rotated_sum2_imag
        output1_real = diff0_real + rotated_diff2_real
        output1_imag = diff0_imag + rotated_diff2_imag
        output2_real = sum0_real - rotated_sum2_real
        output2_imag = sum0_imag - rotated_sum2_imag
        output3_real = diff0_real - rotated_diff2_real
        output3_imag = diff0_imag - rotated_diff2_imag

        quadrant = (offsets >> stage) & 3
        real = tl.where(
            quadrant == 0,
            output0_real,
            tl.where(
                quadrant == 1,
                output1_real,
                tl.where(quadrant == 2, output2_real, output3_real),
            ),
        )
        imag = tl.where(
            quadrant == 0,
            output0_imag,
            tl.where(
                quadrant == 1,
                output1_imag,
                tl.where(quadrant == 2, output2_imag, output3_imag),
            ),
        )

        half: tl.constexpr = 1 << stage

        upper_indices = lower_indices + half

        lower_imag = tl.gather(imag, lower_indices, axis=0)
        upper_real = tl.gather(real, upper_indices, axis=0)
        upper_imag = tl.gather(imag, upper_indices, axis=0)

        angle = lane.to(tl.float32) * (-6.2831853071795864769 / group)
        twiddle_real = tl.cos(angle)
        twiddle_imag = tl.sin(angle)

        product_real = twiddle_real * upper_real - twiddle_imag * upper_imag
        product_imag = twiddle_real * upper_imag + twiddle_imag * upper_real

        is_lower = (offsets & half) == 0
        real = tl.where(
            is_lower,
            lower_real + product_real,
            lower_real - product_real,
        )
        imag = tl.where(
            is_lower,
            lower_imag + product_imag,
            lower_imag - product_imag,
        )

    mirror_indices = (seqlen - offsets) & (seqlen - 1)
    mirror_real = tl.gather(real, mirror_indices, axis=0)
    mirror_imag = -tl.gather(imag, mirror_indices, axis=0)

    sum_real = real + mirror_real
    sum_imag = imag + mirror_imag
    diff_real = real - mirror_real
    diff_imag = imag - mirror_imag

    reconstruction_angle = (
        offsets.to(tl.float32) * (-3.14159265358979323846 / seqlen)

    imag_ptr,
    stride_xb,
    stride_xc,
    stride_xt,

    CHANNELS: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
    FREQ_GROUP: tl.constexpr,

    channel_idx = row - batch_idx * CHANNELS

        batch_idx * stride_xb
        + channel_idx * stride_xc
        + time * stride_xt

        mask=time_mask,

    frequency_mask = frequencies < freq_len
